outcome: The Package Query CLI exposes 14 authorable --where facets. The complete installed Query Space contains 19 facets: 14 exposed by the CLI binding and five used as positional or context facets.

context_or_positional_keys.role: ecosystem population selector, supplied through --ecosystem according to -Q summary; not listed among the binding's --where exposures
package-version context facet; not listed among the binding's --where exposures

library-literal: library-target via --tfm; library-literal and --tfm require each other

required_context.distinction: The complete installed facet graph records a requires edge only for library-literal. The transitive dependency requirements appear in the CLI -Q query summary and shipped query skill, while its facet's authored requires list is empty.

library_target_gesture: Use package query <package ID or PREFIX*> --where "library-literal=<text>" --tfm <one exact NuGet TFM>. library-target is authored by the CLI from --tfm, not through --where; the CLI binding says library-literal and --tfm require each other.
empty_values_input_rules_interpretation: No. An empty values array is not an allow list, and absent/empty registered input rules do not prove unrestricted operand acceptance. library-literal is a specific exception with an explicit rule accepting decoded UTF-16 text subject to length 1..1024 code units and other constraints. That rule cannot be generalized to another facet.

selected_completeness.cli_binding_traversal: Truncated at depth 0; its listed exposes relationship is complete
selected_completeness.input_domain_conclusion: Partial for facets without registered operand rules or closed values

evidence_scope: Installed product discovery and explanation only; no package query or inspection was executed. -Q Packages gave the 14 CLI controls; query-space HAL gave all 19 facets, requires, values, input rules, and embedded CLI binding; linked facet HAL and binding views checked the key relationships and invocation rules.
uncertainties: Input rules are unregistered for exposed dependency-target, depends, depends-ecosystem, depends-transitive, and references, each of which also has an empty listed values array. Their value kinds/examples and CLI summaries guide syntax, but do not define complete operand domains.
The positional/context facets package, prefix, ecosystem, and library-target likewise have empty values and input rules; their complete input domains cannot be inferred from those empty fields.
The installed facet graph has no authored requires edge for depends-transitive despite the CLI's explicit dependency-target/dependency-depth invocation requirement.
reasons_for_extra_fetches: Fetched query-space HAL to compare the complete installed facet membership against the CLI's 14 exposed --where controls.
Fetched transitive and depth facet HAL to check authored requires/input rules against CLI summary.
Fetched library-literal and its emitted required-context href to verify the exact requirement and constrained text rule.
Fetched the emitted CLI binding href to verify --tfm invocation and the completeness of exposed-facet membership.
jq_filters_used: {data_scope, data_states, keys: keys, links: ._links, embedded: ._embedded | keys}
{data_scope, data_states, kind, key, name, requires, input_rules, values, _links, gesture, exposed_facets, summary}
